identity.name: Chronomaster Sport
identity.one_liner: The 2021 Chronomaster Sport — the first Zenith chronograph with a ceramic bezel and the 36,000 vph El Primero 3600 caliber. The watch a collector cites when arguing Zenith belongs in the modern hi-beat conversation.

narrative.story: The Chronomaster Sport is the 2021 release that positioned Zenith against the Rolex Daytona at the under-$10,000 price point. The 41mm stainless steel case, the ceramic unidirectional dive bezel (the first on a Zenith chronograph), the El Primero 3600 caliber (36,000 vph, 60-hour reserve, 1/10th second chronograph), and the tri-color sub-dial layout are the 2021 specification. The Chronomaster Sport is the most-cited modern Zenith and the watch a collector cites when they want a hi-beat automatic chronograph that is not a Daytona.
narrative.collector_notes: The El Primero 3600 measures 1/10th second — the seconds hand makes one revolution per 10 seconds instead of the standard 60. The 36,000 vph rate allows the 1/10th second accuracy.
